name: fivemdiscordbot
description: A discord bot to help with your FiveM server.

scripts.petro-start: npm run build && cd dist && npm run pushcmds && node src/server/server.js
scripts.build: rimraf dist/ && tsc --build && npm run copy-files && npm run copy-config && webpack build && rimraf dist/src/server/ && copyfiles -u 1 tmp/server.js dist/src/server/ && copyfiles -u 1 tmp/regester-commands.js dist/src/server/bot/ && rimraf tmp/ dist/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.watch:build: tsc --build && npm run copy-files && npm run copy-config && webpack build && rimraf dist/src/server/ && copyfiles -u 1 tmp/server.js dist/src/server/ && copyfiles -u 1 tmp/regester-commands.js dist/src/server/bot/ && rimraf tmp/ dist/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
